$comment: Tiering for the FixPortal Piston fork. Template and rationale for every shared entry:
Repo-specific HIGH: this repo IS a sandbox. The image definition, the isolate
invocation and limits (api/src/job.js, config.js), the entrypoint that sets up the
cgroup, and the baked-in runtime packages decide what submitted code can reach.
scripts/** is HIGH because the gated Smoke test job runs scripts/smoke.py, and
the image build runs scripts/install-package.sh as root.
LOW: docs/** is upstream's mkdocs site; nothing here deploys it. Markdown is not
shipped by the image (.dockerignore is an allow-list).
